title: Average-and Last-Iterate Lower Bounds for Optimistic Matrix Mirror-Prox in Quantum Zero-Sum Games
abstract: arXiv:2609.38835v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Optimistic matrix mirror-prox (OMMP) computes $\epsilon$-approximate Nash equilibria in quantum zero-sum games with an $O(1/\varepsilon)$ average-iterate guarantee [arXiv:2311.10859]. We investigate whether this dependence on accuracy is tight and whether geometric last-iterate convergence can be guaranteed. We study these questions through explicit games with one qubit per player. First, we prove an $\Omega(1/\varepsilon)$ lower bound for the uniform-average output that includes the maximally mixed initial state, independently of the regularizer and step size. Second, we construct a fixed game on which optimistic gradient descent-ascent (OGDA), initialized at the maximally mixed state, has last-iterate Frobenius distance to equilibrium $\Theta(1/t)$ and duality gap $\Theta(1/t^3)$ for every sufficiently small fixed step size. translated_title: 量子零和博弈中乐观矩阵镜像邻近算法（OMMP）的平均迭代与最后迭代下界
translated_abstract: 乐观矩阵镜像邻近算法（OMMP）能够以 O(1/ε) 的平均迭代保证在量子零和博弈中计算 ε-近似纳什均衡。我们研究这种对精度的依赖关系是否是紧密的，以及是否能够保证几何级的最后迭代收敛。我们通过每个玩家仅含一个量子比特的显式博弈来研究这些问题。首先，我们证明了均匀平均输出的 Ω(1/ε) 下界，该下界涵盖最大混合初始状态，且与正则化函数和步长无关。其次，我们构造了一个固定博弈，在该博弈上，从最大混合状态初始化的乐观梯度下降-上升算法（OGDA）在任意足够小的固定步长下，其最后迭代到均衡的弗罗贝尼乌斯距离为 Θ(1/t)，对偶间隙为 Θ(1/t³)。另一个固定博弈则表现出在将初始误差降低一个常数因子时存在任意长的延迟……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明了量子零和博弈中OMMP算法的O(1/ε)平均迭代收敛率是紧密的（达到Ω(1/ε)下界），并通过显式构造的固定博弈表明最后迭代收敛仅为Θ(1/t)距离和Θ(1/t³)对偶间隙，从而排除了几何级收敛的可能性。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the O(1/ε) average-iterate guarantee of optimistic matrix mirror-prox in quantum zero-sum games is tight via an Ω(1/ε) lower bound, and constructs explicit fixed games showing last-iterate convergence is limited to Θ(1/t) distance and Θ(1/t³) duality gap, ruling out geometric convergence.
